    PUT THE MENTAL MODEL TO WORK

    YOUR FIRST NATIVE SCREEN

    Take the notes app into Xcode.

    A small, complete SwiftUI project. Shared state, adaptive navigation, labeled system actions, and no fixed screen sizes.

    Download the Xcode starter ↓Swift 6 · iOS 26+ · built with the iOS 27.1 SDK
    1. Open. Unzip and open DuoNotes.xcodeproj in Xcode 27.1 or later.
    2. Run. Choose an iPhone Duo simulator and press Run. Hardware needs your signing team.
    3. Try. Edit a note. Fold, unfold, rotate, and narrow the window. Check that the selection and draft survive.

    Drafts stay in memory during the app session. Relaunching resets the sample. The included README has the source map and device-testing checklist.
